title: Flexible work: a legal pathway to gender equality
discussion_signal: The post links legal rights to adjust working hours and remote work with women’s labour-force participation and work-life balance. It makes time policy a form of care and economic infrastructure, while showing that legal availability remains uneven across countries.
linked_research_question: How do working-time rules and care-compatible employment conditions shape gendered participation, income, and autonomy?
limits: Legal rights do not establish workplace uptake or lived flexibility
No country-specific implementation examples are presented
